A breed of '''coral''' was found exclusively on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The [[Coral/Legends|coral]] was particularly dense and was therefore used to create [[coral pike]]s, a traditional [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] melee weapon that shared some similarity with [[Force pike/Legends|Force pikes]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The coral was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' expansion ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
